game_start.intro: Ka timata te kēmu. Kākahu whakaū: {trump_suit} (kāri whakaū: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaitākaro {player_id} i Whist Tiamana.
{phase_info}
E uaua ana koe ki {hand_size} kāri.
Tākaro kāri ki '[play N]', ki te wahi o tēnei kāri i tō ringa (hei tauira '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: WHAKAARO: ko te toa o ia tinihanga ka tango i te kāri kanohi-ake, a ka toia e te ngaro te kāti muri mai i te papa. Kaore nga mahi tinihangatia i wikitoria ki tenei waahanga kaore he angitu.
player_prompt.phase_playing: KAUPAPU: kua pau te papa. Ka whai wāhi mai ngā tinihanga katoa ki te wikitoria i tēnei wā.

next_card.playing_phase: Kāore he kāri e tukuna ana - kua tīmata te wāhanga tākaro.
next_card.deck_empty: He kau te papa - kāore he kāri e wātea ana.

invalid_move.wrong_format: He hōputu nekehanga hē. Whakamahia te '[play N]' hei whakatangi i te kāri Nth kei to ringa.
invalid_move.bad_position: Kāore i te tīari taua tūnga kāri. Kei a koe ngā {hand_size} kāri, heoi anō ka taea e au te whakamahi i tēnei pūmanawa hei tāpiri ki tō kōpae pānuitanga.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Me whai koe i te tauira me te tākaro kāri {lead_suit}.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Kāore e taea te whakatangi i taua kāri.

game_action.played: Ka takaro te kaitākaro {player_id} i a ia e tākaro ana ki te {card}.

trick.won: Ka wikitoria te kaitākaro {winner_id} i te tinihanga ki a {card}.
trick.won_learning: Kaitākaro {winner_id} toa ki te pōti whai ki runga ki {card}, ā, ka tango i te kāri kanohi tuara.

phase.learning_complete: Kua pau te papa. Ka mutu te wāhanga ako - ka whai wāhi atu ki te wikitoria ngā tinihanga katoa e toe ana.

draw.winner_received: I wikitoria koe i te tinihanga, ā, ka whiwhi {card}.
draw.loser_received: Kua ngaro koe i te tinihanga, a ka tangohia e {card} mai i te papa.
draw.winner_preview: Ko te kāri e whai ake nei ko {card}.

turn.scores_learning: Pōti whai kua wini - Kaitākaro 0: {tricks0}, Kaitākaro 1: {tricks1}
turn.phase_learning: Tūtohinga: {phase} ({remaining_cards} kāri pōti mai i te pū)

hand.no_cards_in_hand: Kāore he kāri i te ringa.
hand.trump_indicator: (TRUMP) Ko te mea nui, ko nga mahi a Trump.

trick_view.empty: Kāore he kāri i whakatangihia anō tēnei tinihanga.
trick_view.trump_indicator: (TRUMP) Ko te mea nui, ko nga mahi a Trump.
